$comment: Shared fixture for keyboard-entry answers in the choice drills (issue #232), consumed by BOTH ports: android AnswerEntryTest and ios MorseKitCheck. Data, not code — see CLAUDE.md's two-ports rule. Values written by hand from the rules below, not captured from either port.

rules.ladder: Rungs are fourChoices → sixChoices → typed. Each answer on a rung joins a window of the last `window` answers on that rung. When the window is full and holds at least `requiredCorrect` correct answers, the ladder moves up one rung and the window empties. typed is the top: answers there change nothing. A level restart ('L') returns to fourChoices with an empty window.
rules.events: One letter per event: 'c' a correct answer, 'x' a wrong one, 'L' a level restart. `promotions` lists the zero-based event index at which each promotion happened and the rung it reached.
rules.normalize: Upper case; surrounding whitespace trimmed; runs of inner whitespace collapsed to one space; a slashed zero Ø read as the digit 0.
rules.gradeCharacter: For a single-character target: correct when the normalized answer is the target. Otherwise the answer is a confusion partner only when it normalizes to exactly one character that has a Morse code; anything else — blank, two or more characters, a symbol with no code — is a miss with no partner (confusedWith null).

ladder.name: twenty straight correct clear four choices
nineteen correct are not yet a full window
two misses in a full window still clear it
three misses hold the rung until one slides out
the window slides: the oldest miss leaves on the twenty-first answer
the window empties on promotion, so six choices are earned on their own answers
a new level starts again at four choices
a level restart empties the window
a new level from typing starts again at four choices
